verdict.rationale: Composio's Triggers docs explicitly describe event-driven subscriptions: connected app events (new Slack message, GitHub commit, incoming email) are pushed as structured payloads to a registered webhook URL, signed for verification, rather than requiring polling. This is a first-party documented, dedicated feature (not just inferred) for subscribing agents to downstream app events. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that triggers work reliably in production and more detail on trigger configuration/filtering granularity.
